description: An arcaded courtyard at dusk with crenellated walls and two minarets behind. A robed, bearded man in a turban stands on the right with one arm raised, addressing a group of turbaned men seated on rugs around lamplight. A second standing man in a dark robe holds a sheet of paper. Lanterns and an oil lamp light the stone floor. Painterly, warm and dark tones, no visible text, no frame.
